card.name: The 'po' start of poison
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word poison when it is split, as in 'a PO|ISON control center' or 'www.po|ison.org'. It appears in poison control referrals and, rarely, in hyphenated terms like 'cyanide-poisoned'.

modes.label: Poison control referral
modes.description: The 'po' piece of poison in the phone and website text that sends readers to a poison control center.
